content:
Let \(n\) be the number of bouquets. Each bouquet uses \(3k,7k,5k,9k\) tulips, so \(24k\) flowers total. Since \(24 \le 24k \le 50\), \(k=1\) or \(k=2\).

For no leftovers:
\[
3kn=21 \implies kn=7
\]
but
\[
7kn=91 \implies kn=13,
\]
a contradiction. Thus no positive integer \(n\) satisfies the conditions.

\(\boxed{\text{No such bouquets possible}}\)
